title: Run, build and hand out a React Native app
tagline: Pick the device, build the release file, send it to testers.
intro: The commands you type every day: choose which emulator or phone the app lands on, build an APK, and put it in front of testers with Firebase.

blocks.caption: One pass from a connected device to a tester's phone.

items.label: Find the device
items.detail: adb devices and the simulator list give the id each run command needs
explain: adb devices prints one line per Android target, emulators as emulator-5556 and phones as a serial such as e18316bd0601.
On iOS the simulator is picked by name, e.g. "iPhone 8", and a cable-connected device by the name set on the phone.

items.label: Run on it
items.detail: --deviceId, --simulator or --device sends the build to that target instead of the first found
explain: Without a flag the CLI takes whichever device answers first, which is rarely the one you meant when two are attached.
yarn android --deviceId="emulator-5556" pins the Android run; yarn ios --simulator="iPhone 8" does the same for iOS.

items.label: Build the APK
items.detail: gradlew assembleRelease writes the release APK under android/app/build/outputs/apk/release
explain: clean first: a stale build folder is the usual cause of a release that still shows yesterday's JavaScript.
Keep it as a package.json script so nobody has to remember the cd into android and back.

items.label: Send to testers
items.detail: Firebase App Distribution uploads the APK and emails the testers a download link
explain: firebase appdistribution:distribute takes the absolute path to the APK and --app with the Firebase app id, e.g. 1:362500748669:android:f6fd….
The app id is in Project settings → Your apps, or printed by firebase apps:list once you are logged in.

blocks.caption: List the targets, then run on one of them
A script in package.json, so a release build is yarn build-apk
A simulator by model, a real device by its name

body: xcrun simctl list devices shows every simulator name the --simulator flag accepts.

sections.title: Distribute with Firebase
sections.summary: Testers get an email instead of a file in a chat.

items: Install the Firebase CLI with the script below.
firebase login, then firebase projects:list to check you are in the right account.
Add testers or a tester group in the console's App Distribution tab.
Run distribute with the APK path and the app id.
